meta.name: Chhal Kapat The Deception
meta.description:
When a famous influencer is found dead during a destination wedding in a remote village, a cynical yet brilliant cop unearths dark secrets, hidden betrayals, and shocking truths, as every guest becomes a suspect in a twisted web of love.

Rated U/A 13+ · Returning Series · First aired 6 Jun 2025 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Juggernaut Productions · Network: ZEE5

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: Shaadi Aur Secrets
videos.overview: SP Devika Rathod’s seemingly routine transfer to Burhanpur takes a dark turn when a guest is found dead at an intimate destination wedding.

videos.title: #LastPost
videos.overview: Devika’s investigation reveals the shocking truth that the victim, Shalu, was pregnant! As Devika digs deeper into Shalu’s life, even the closest people seem to have secrets.

videos.title: Apradhee 9
videos.overview: The news of @MissKnowItAll’s death floats all over social media, pushing Devika to act fast. While everything points to a simple suicide, her instincts tell her otherwise.

videos.title: Kaatil Kaun?
videos.overview: As Devika digs deeper, buried grudges among Shalu's friends become more visible. Devika begins to doubt that there could be more than one person involved in killing Shalu!

videos.title: Sach Aur Saboot
videos.overview: A hypnotherapy session confirms Devika’s fears that the truth is hidden behind carefully constructed lies. With many plots in play, Devika realises that someone is protecting the culprit.

videos.title: Aakhri Kadi
videos.overview: The disappearance of one guest and an unexpected confession baffle the police. Devika waits for the final DNA results, only to realise that the culprit has been in plain sight all along.

videos.title: Uss Raat Ki Kahaani
videos.overview: Devika arrives to make the final arrest, but an overlooked detail flips the case. As the case nears its end Devika sets out to confront her past.
